basis: When each program is started, from its scheduler. Times are UTC start times; a run's update lands some minutes later. Most programs are started by the suite's dispatcher (tic-dispatch), because GitHub's own scheduled runs fire hours late for these repositories; their own crons are the fallback.
late_rule: Late when the last update is more than two expected intervals plus half an hour old at the time of COP's picture: at least one run was missed, allowing for the time a run takes.

watchfloor.runs: Reads GDELT every 15 minutes; its items are whole UTC days, closed after 03:15 the next day

vigil.runs: Its worker wakes at 15 and 45 past each hour and reads each source when it is due: most hourly, others every 6 hours or daily

noisefloor.runs: Once a UTC day: the ADS-B day job from 04:25, the satellite and ground-station jobs from 04:50 to 22:30

orbit.runs: 00:55, 06:55, 12:55 and 18:55; the satellite catalog once a day at 17:30

wake.runs: 04:55, 10:55, 16:55 and 22:55; IMF PortWatch itself publishes weekly
